summary_title_01: We will take [Client] from a blueprint to a business case in two phases over 24 weeks
objective_01: Develop a new business model centered on a digital marketplace to secure competitive advantage going forward.
objective_02: Open new revenue streams and future-proof the business, without major cannibalization or short-term loss.
objective_03: Develop and scale the marketplace with minimal cannibalization; scale globally quickly by leveraging existing assets.
objective_04: Keep strategic control without losing speed; make sure learnings flow back into the parent organization.
solution_01: The work will run 24 weeks in two phases, one after the other.
solution_02: Design (6 weeks): Get answers to the key questions to create the blueprint.
solution_03: Pilot (18 weeks): Build first version and launch with small user group. Test and iterate.
solution_04: The rollout after the pilot will stay outside the two phases.
outcome_01: Blueprint with filled-out hypotheses on each component
outcome_03: Detailed project plan for the Pilot phase
outcome_04: Full business case including detailed implementation plan and roadmap
